title: centaurea atrata subsp. nigrofimbria
intro: Centaurea atrata subsp. nigrofimbria, commonly known as Black Knapweed or Black Flower Knapweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea atrata subsp. nigrofimbria are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
